western-ghats-endemics.ariaLabel: Map of southern India showing the 10-day Western Ghats Endemics route: Thattekad, Munnar with day visits to Pampadum Shola and Eravikulam, Chinnar, Top Slip, Valparai, Ooty with a day visit to Mukurthi, and Bandipur. Arrival via Kochi airport; departure via Mysuru or Bengaluru airport.
western-ghats-endemics.note: Straight lines show the order of travel, not roads. Shaded band: the Western Ghats.

monsoon-rainforest-nights.ariaLabel: Map of western peninsular India with the Western Ghats rainforest belt shaded. The exact rainforest base is set at booking.
monsoon-rainforest-nights.note: Approximate region: the Western Ghats rainforest belt. The exact base and night-walk sites are set at booking.

central-india-big-cats.ariaLabel: Map of central India with an approximate shaded area for the central Indian tiger reserves. The exact parks are set at booking.
central-india-big-cats.note: Approximate region: the central Indian tiger reserves. The exact parks and safari zones are set at booking.

himalaya-birds-mountain-wildlife.ariaLabel: Map of northern India with the Indian Himalaya shaded. The exact route and base are set at booking.
himalaya-birds-mountain-wildlife.note: Approximate region: the Indian Himalaya. The exact route, base and altitude are set at booking.

overview.ariaLabel: Map of India marking four trip regions: the Western Ghats Endemics route in the far south-west, the Monsoon Rainforest belt along the Western Ghats, the central Indian tiger reserves, and the Indian Himalaya.
overview.note: Shaded areas are approximate; exact parks and bases are set at booking.
